jobs.occupation: Multi-skilled maintenance technician - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

• Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
• Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers
You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

• Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field
• Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written
• Already living in Belgium, preferably in the greater area of Oostkamp
Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not required, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC...

jobs.occupation: Operations Coordinator - Dutch & German speaking m/f/d (Callcenteragent/in)
jobs.description:
**Location:**  Ghent

Client confidential

Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future? If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. 

This is us, your new colleagues

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.

This is the job

- Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind.
- Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress.
- A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box.
- Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business 

Are you the one?

- You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers.
- You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported.
- You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset.
- You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up.
- You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills.
- You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients.
- You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Dutch and German.

A perfect match? Just some of the benefits working for us...

- Competitive salary, with meal vouchers, transport costs, shift allowance, etc.
- Well-being services
- Restaurant on site
- Opportunity to grow within the company
- Good work life balance
- International environment
- Support in relocation when moving from abroad

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

jobs.occupation: Store Assistant / Sales Associate – Christmas Shop | Bruges | Full-Time
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working in a welcoming retail environment and love the magic of Christmas? Do you enjoy helping customers find the perfect decorations for the holiday season?

For a unique Christmas store in the heart of Bruges, we are looking for an enthusiastic Store Assistant / Sales Associate who will help customers bring the Christmas spirit into their homes.

What will you do?
As a Sales Associate, you will be the face of the store and ensure that every customer enjoys a warm and pleasant shopping experience.

Your responsibilities include:

• Welcoming and assisting customers in a friendly manner
• Advising customers on Christmas decorations, ornaments, gifts and seasonal products
• Maintaining an attractive and organized store presentation
• Restocking shelves and keeping the store clean and tidy
• Processing payments and handling cash register duties
• Assisting with deliveries and unpacking new merchandise

• You enjoy working with customers and providing excellent service
• You are willing to work weekends on a rotating schedule
• Previous retail or sales experience is an advantage
• You speak Spanish, Dutch or English fluently
• In addition to your strongest language, you can communicate at a basic level in at least one of the other languages
• You enjoy working in an international environment with tourists and visitors from different countries
• You are enthusiastic, reliable and enjoy working as part of a team

As a future butcher / deboner of pork meat, you will work on different lines with tasks such as cutting shoulders, bellies, and ribs. 

Experience is an asset, but motivated newcomers are welcome. 

Thanks to the Butchers Academy, you will receive comprehensive training, followed by a permanent contract and annual evaluations offering opportunities for advancement.

We are looking for ambitious and eager-to-learn individuals who can start early (start at 4.55 AM) and are flexible in their schedules depending on the season. 

You should be comfortable working in a cold environment and have an affinity for the food industry (pork meat), along with the associated quality and hygiene standards. 

You must be physically capable of standing and working all day and place importance on workplace safety. 

Language is not a barrier; everyone has equal opportunities, whether you speak English, French, or Dutch.

About the Role
Are you a hands-on technical professional who enjoys troubleshooting industrial equipment as much as carrying out practical maintenance and repair work?

For an industrial production site in Louvain-la-Neuve, we are looking for an Electromechanic & Technical Handyman to join the team.

This is a varied role combining 50% industrial electromechanical maintenance and 50% general technical maintenance. You will play an important role in ensuring the reliability of the production line while keeping the company's facilities and infrastructure in good condition.

Your Responsibilities
50% – Electromechanical Maintenance
Monitor the production line and identify technical faults or malfunctions.
Diagnose electrical and mechanical problems and determine their root causes.
Carry out repairs and implement effective technical solutions to minimize production downtime.
Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on production equipment.
Check the proper functioning of machines and production installations.
Inspect electrical wiring and cabling and carry out troubleshooting when necessary.
Identify potential technical improvements to increase equipment reliability and performance.
Follow all applicable safety, quality and hygiene procedures.
50% – Technical Handyman & Facility Maintenance
Carry out general maintenance and repair work throughout the company.
Perform painting, minor renovation and finishing work.
Repair and maintain gates, doors and other company infrastructure.
Handle minor electrical, mechanical and technical repairs within your area of competence.
Identify maintenance needs and take the necessary corrective actions.
Ensure that buildings, facilities and work areas remain safe, functional and well maintained.
Support the team with various practical maintenance tasks as required.

We are looking for a versatile, hands-on professional with a strong technical background and a proactive approach.

You ideally have:

Previous experience in industrial maintenance.
Good knowledge of industrial electricity and mechanics.
Strong knowledge of electrical wiring and cabling.
The ability to diagnose faults, identify their causes and find practical solutions.
Knowledge of pneumatics, hydraulics or automation is an advantage.
Experience in the food, pharmaceutical or chemical industry is a strong asset.
Practical skills in general maintenance, repairs and basic building work.
A good understanding of safety procedures and technical instructions.
A structured, methodical and independent approach to your work.
A strong sense of responsibility, flexibility and problem-solving skills.

 

Languages
English: Very good proficiency.
French: Very good proficiency.
You must be comfortable communicating in both languages in a professional working environment.

Working Hours
Monday to Friday.
Flexible working schedule between 06:00 and 22:00, depending on the company's operational needs.
Availability to work within this time window is required.

jobs.occupation: IT Support Technician – L1 Resident Engineer (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
As L1 Resident Engineer, you are the first point of contact for all IT incidents and requests on site. You combine deskside support and helpdesk. 

User support
  
• Provide Level 1 IT support, on site and remotely, to employees at the Liège site 
• Diagnose and resolve common incidents: laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, printers, headsets and peripherals 
• Support Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365 environments (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive), as well as basic application support 
• Resolve basic connectivity issues (LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN) 
• Support meeting rooms and videoconferencing equipment (Teams, cameras, microphones, screens)  
Access and security
  
• Manage access: accounts, password resets, MFA and authentication, in line with security procedures 
• Apply IT security policies and immediately report any suspicious incident (phishing, malware, unauthorised access)  
Hardware and lifecycle
  
• Install, configure and prepare IT equipment (PCs, iOS/Android mobile devices, peripherals) 
• Handle IT onboarding and offboarding of employees (workstation preparation, handover and collection of equipment, access rights) 
• Keep the IT inventory up to date and coordinate replacements, warranties, repairs and disposals 
• Tickets, escalation and coordination 
• Log, prioritise, track and close tickets in the ITSM tool (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management…) 
• Escalate complex incidents to L2/L3 teams with a full diagnosis, and follow them up in line with SLAs 
• Act as the link with central IT teams, service providers and external suppliers 
• Inform local management of major incidents or service interruptions 
• Contribute to IT documentation (knowledge base, procedures, troubleshooting guides)  
You are not just a ticket-taker: you are the local IT point of reference and help ensure the continuity of the site's IT services.
 
THE TEAM & THE MANAGER
 
Based at the Liège office, you report directly to the Station Manager, Pierre Jeurissen. You work closely with SAL International's IT teams in Belgium and Saudi Arabia.

Essential 
 
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent technical qualification in IT 
• At least 2 years' experience in helpdesk, service desk, desktop support or field support 
• Fluent French and English, both spoken and written 
• Strong command of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365; basic knowledge of Active Directory / Entra ID (Azure AD) and MFA 
• Basic knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP) and cybersecurity  
Assets
  
• Knowledge of Arabic 
• Experience as a Resident Engineer / Onsite Support Engineer 
• Experience in the aviation or logistics sector, in an international environment 
• IT certifications (CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation, Microsoft…)  
Soft skills
  
• Customer focus and service mindset 
• Autonomy and rigour in incident management 
• Clear communication with non-technical users 
• Hands-on, proactive attitude
